title: Page 4
slug: 捡夫宝娘子-金妍-戚家四兄弟只剩他戚无双这个当家老大还未娶妻-看弟弟们恩爱成双加上每天被媒婆们当大肥羊紧盯著-他烦不胜烦
content_zh:
“大夫出诊一次一两银，总共来两次，但第二次只是简单复诊，大夫只收二百文的出诊费，一帖药一百文钱，总共四十五帖，妳一天食膳花费虽然是五十文钱，但我只能算三分之一，另外三分之二是妳和贵叔吃走的，不该算到我头上，另外虽然妳帮我准备了五套换洗衣裳，但这衣裳是旧的，依我的目测价值顶多只剩五十文钱，不能算全新时的价，所以……”他将算好的算盘移回她面前，笑得比她更是奸诈。“六两又二百文钱，宝小姐，这样算似乎比较正确，妳觉得呢？”
“……”她看了看算盘，又看了看他的笑脸，她觉得自己已经够会算了，没想到竟遇到一个比她更会算的男人。
被他这样东砍一点，西砍一些，就硬生生少了二两又五十文钱，两千零五十文钱，四分之一呀！
“对了，要我做牛做马，一个月只能抵一两银挺不划算的，至少也要二两银，这样我大约四个多月就能够还完债，不过……妳放心，我还是会在这儿附近找一个工作挣钱，绝不会再给妳多添麻烦。”
“……”二两银？他是从哪里觉得自己够值二两银的？
“这样，还有问题吗？”戚无双翩然笑问，她那目瞪口呆兼大受打击的表情真是有趣，怎么看都看不腻呢！
要论到钱的事情，她遇到了他，简直就像是小巫见大巫，她肯定是比不过的。
宝安儿瞪着他的笑脸，猛然惊觉自己根本完全不了解他，他脸上的笑容，她之前居然会觉得好看，甚至还有怦然心动的感觉，但此时此刻，她才明白……这全是欺骗人的错觉呀！
哪里好看了？那明明就是奸笑、奸笑。
她到底救了什么样的牛鬼蛇神回家？现在后悔还来得及吗？
“宝小姐，妳还有疑问吗？”虽然她呆愣的表情很逗人，但他可不想一直和她大眼瞪小眼下去。
她怔愣了好一会儿，回过神后，问出此刻心中最大的疑惑——
“你……在失忆前该不会是什么奸商吧？”
第2章(1)
戚无双走在宣河县的街道上，寻找无戚钱庄早在此的分号。
方才他拿“找工作”的借口出门，宝安儿欢喜地送他送到大门口，还一脸期待他能尽快顺利地找到工作。
想到她问自己是不是奸商？说实话，戚无双倒是不介意这个词套在自己身上，他无所谓。
做生意要是没有自己的独特手段，又怎么有办法赢过其他的生意人？所以在必要的时候，使出一点小手段，那也是无可厚非的事。
所以，她说他是奸商，他一点都不介意，而她也是第一个敢当着他的面这样说他的人。虽然她根本就不知道他的真正身份，但敢把话说得这么直接，还是满有胆识的。
“呵……真是个既矛盾，又爱斤斤计较的奇怪姑娘……”

走了好一会儿，戚无双终于找到无戚钱庄的所在，毫不犹豫地走了进去。
伙计一看到有人上门，并没有因为戚无双的穿着普通而有厌恶神色，还是有礼地询问：“请问有事吗？”
“我想找周掌柜。”戚无双也有礼地笑答。
“你找我们掌柜有什么事？”
“你只要告诉他，我叫“戚无双”，周掌柜肯定会见我。”
“戚无双？”伙计困惑地微皱眉头，总觉得好像在哪儿听过这个名字，紧接着恍然大悟，赶紧进到内房通报。“您……您请稍等，小的马上去请周掌柜！”
过没多久，就见周掌柜匆匆跑出来，又惊又喜。“大公子，谢天谢地，您可平安无事地出现了！”
戚无双自从半个多月前遇到船难后，就失去消息，幸存游上岸的戚无双随从，赶紧将此事捎回京城戚家，惊动了戚家人。
戚家马上派人过来，并且运用关系让附近的县太爷调动兵马，一起沿着河往下游到处寻找，却没有半点线索，早已急得像热锅上的蚂蚁。
宣河县亦在河流流经处，所以周掌柜也接到戚家指示，帮忙注意有没有戚无双的消息，而无戚钱庄各分号的掌柜，都是在京城总号经过磨练才外派出来的，全见过戚无双，就算已有几年没见，周掌柜还是一眼就认出他来。
戚无双毫不吝惜地称赞道：“周掌柜，看来你把这一处的钱庄分号管理得不错，我很满意。”光看伙计刚才对他的态度，不卑不亢，就可以知道，周掌柜管教得当。
“感谢大公子的称赞，请大公子进内房坐下，让小的好生招待。”周掌柜欣喜地招呼着，不只是因为戚无双安然无恙，也因为自己被赞赏。
两人进到内房里，周掌柜请戚无双坐在主位，吩咐伙计赶紧泡杯茶过来，之后才询问：“大公子，这段日子到底是发生什么事了？”
“一切说来话长……”他的眼眸闪过一抹兴味，简单交代被救起的经过，倒是没将他“欠债”的事情说出口。
她肯定恨不得他早早还完债离开，但她越是这么想，他就越想拖得久一点，存心和她唱反调。
周掌柜在大略了解情况之后，便问：“大公子，小的会以最快速度安排您回京，在等待的这段时间，您要不要先改住到小的家里？”
虽然大公子现在住在恩人家，但宝家衰败已久，衣食方面肯定不怎么好，完全配不上大公子的身份。
“不必麻烦，我暂时还不想回京，也不会改住到你那里。”他很干脆地拒绝。
“嗄？为什么？”周掌柜讶异地瞪大双眼。
“反正你只要回报我平安无事就好，这段时间我会和你们保持联系，而且别让其他人知道我的真正身份。”他对宝安儿很有兴趣，还不想太早离开，如果他的真实身份太早曝光，那就不好玩了，因此他打算暂时维持着目前的身份，赖在他身边不走。

因为看过太多为了他显赫的家世而向攀附的女人，让他对唯利是图的女人极为厌恶，不信这样的女人会有真心。
照理说，宝安儿也该会是让他厌恶的女人才是，但她又和那些女人不太一样，虽然她斤斤计较，但她却救了落难、身无分文，看来“无利可图”的他。
如果她真的唯利是图，何必要救他，还一路照顾到他痊愈？
他可不信她说得“一时失手”的可笑理由，况且她虽然嘴上总是抱怨，但该照顾的地方也是一样不少，这正是他对她感兴趣，并且想要好好了解的原因。
“小的知道了。”周掌柜虽然不懂戚无双到底在想些什么，但柱子都这么决定了，他这个做下属当然照做就是。
“对了周掌柜，对于宝家的事情，你知道多少？”他们鲜少说自己的事情，所以他只知道个大概，当然也不方便直接问他们，只好问旁人了。
“宝家在宣河县还算有名气，他们家发生的事情，也是大家茶余饭后喜欢讨论的，小的可以把所知道的事情全告诉大公子。”
“那就快说，越详细越好。”戚无双点点头，很期待能从周掌柜口中听到些什么。
“宝家在宣河县本事经营古董买卖的富贵之家，宝老爷有一儿一女，儿子叫宝康，女儿就是宝安儿，宝夫人在生下女儿没几年就因病过世，宝老爷则在三年前被活活气死了。”
“怎么回事？”戚无双讶异地挑眉。
“因为宝康是个游手好闲的纨绔子弟，成天只知道去赌坊鬼混，短短几年之内就败掉宝家一半的家产，宝老爷和儿子起争执，但宝康始终冥顽不灵，三年前的一天宝老爷真的被活活气死了，在宝老爷死后，宝家仆人便陆续离开，现在只剩下一个贵叔不肯走。”
content_en:
"The doctor pays one tael for each visit, two times in total, but the second time is just a simple follow-up visit. The doctor only charges two hundred cents for the consultation, and one hundred cents for each medicine, forty-five treatments in total. Although your daily meal cost is fifty cents, I can only calculate one-third, and the other two-thirds are for you and your money. I shouldn't be blamed for what my uncle ate away. In addition, although you prepared five sets of clothes for me, these clothes are old, and according to my visual estimation, the value is only fifty cents at most, which cannot be considered as the price when they were brand new, so..." He moved the calculated abacus back to her, and his smile was even more cunning than hers. "Six taels and two hundred cents, Miss Bao, this calculation seems more correct, what do you think?"
"..." She looked at the abacus and then at his smiling face. She thought she was good at calculations, but she didn't expect to meet a man who was better at calculations than her.
When he cut a little east and west like this, he suddenly lost two taels and fifty cents, two thousand and fifty cents, a quarter!
"By the way, it's not cost-effective for me to work as a cow or a horse. I can only pay one tael of silver a month. I need at least 2 taels of silver. In this way, I can pay off the debt in about four months. But... don't worry, I will still find a job to earn money near here, and I will never cause you any more trouble."
"..." Two taels of silver? How did he feel that he was worth two taels of silver?
"In this case, are there any questions?" Qi Wushuang asked with a smile. Her stunned and shocked expression was really interesting. I'll never get tired of watching it!
When it came to money, when she met him, he was like a small witch, and she was definitely incomparable.
Bao An'er stared at his smiling face and suddenly realized that she didn't understand him at all. She had thought the smile on his face was beautiful before, and even made her heart beat up. But at this moment, she realized...this was all a deceptive illusion!
Where does it look good? That's obviously a cunning smile, a cynical smile.
What kind of monster did she save and bring home? Is it too late to regret now?
"Miss Bao, do you still have any questions?" Although her blank expression was very funny, he didn't want to stare at her all the time.
She was stunned for a while. After she came to her senses, she asked the biggest doubt in her heart at the moment——
"You...were you a profiteer before you lost your memory?"
Chapter 2(1)
Qi Wushuang walked on the streets of Xuanhe County, looking for the branch of Wuqi Bank that had been here for a long time.
Just now he used the excuse of "looking for a job" to go out, and Bao An'er happily sent him to the gate, looking forward to him finding a job as soon as possible and smoothly.
Thinking of her asking herself if she was a profiteer? To be honest, Qi Wushuang didn't mind the word being applied to him, he didn't care.
If you don’t have your own unique means of doing business, how can you beat other businessmen? Therefore, it is understandable to resort to small means when necessary.
Therefore, he didn't mind at all when she called him a profiteer, and she was the first person who dared to say so in front of him. Although she didn't know his true identity at all, she was brave enough to speak so directly.
"Haha... What a strange girl who is both contradictory and caressing..."
After walking for a while, Qi Wushuang finally found the location of Wuqi Bank and walked in without hesitation.
When the waiter saw someone coming to the door, he didn't look disgusted because of Qi Wushuang's ordinary clothes. He still asked politely: "Excuse me, what's the matter?"
"I want to see Shopkeeper Zhou." Qi Wushuang also smiled politely.
"What do you want from our shopkeeper?"
"You just need to tell him that my name is "Qi Wushuang", and Shopkeeper Zhou will definitely meet me."
"Qi Wushuang?" The waiter frowned slightly in confusion, feeling as if he had heard this name somewhere before. Then he suddenly realized it and hurried into the inner room to report. "You...please wait a moment. I'll go ask Shopkeeper Zhou immediately."! "
Not long after, I saw Shopkeeper Zhou running out in a hurry, feeling surprised and happy. "Master, thank God you showed up safe and sound! "
There has been no news about Qi Wushuang since he encountered a shipwreck more than half a month ago. Qi Wushuang's entourage, who survived and swam ashore, quickly reported the matter back to the Qi family in the capital, alarming the Qi family.
The Qi family immediately sent someone over, and used their connections to ask the nearby county magistrate to mobilize troops and search everywhere along the lower reaches of the river. However, there was no clue at all, and they were already as anxious as ants on a hot pot.
Xuanhe County is also where the river flows, so Shopkeeper Zhou also received instructions from the Qi family to help pay attention to whether there is any news about Qi Wushuang. The shopkeepers of each branch of Wuqi Bank were all trained in the main office in Beijing before being sent out. They have all met Qi Wushuang. Even if they haven't seen him for several years, Shopkeeper Zhou still recognizes him at a glance.
Qi Wushuang praised without hesitation: "Shopkeeper Zhou, it seems that you have managed this bank branch well, I am very satisfied. "Just looking at the waiter's attitude towards him just now, which was neither humble nor arrogant, you can tell that Shopkeeper Zhou has disciplined him properly.
"Thank you for your compliments. Please come into the inner room and sit down, so that the young master can entertain you. " Shopkeeper Zhou greeted happily, not only because Qi Wushuang was safe and sound, but also because he was appreciated.
The two of them entered the inner room. Shopkeeper Zhou asked Qi Wushuang to sit at the head table and ordered the waiter to quickly make a cup of tea. Then he asked: "My eldest son, what happened these days? "
"It's all a long story..." His eyes flashed with interest, and he briefly explained how he was rescued, but did not mention his "debt".
She definitely wanted him to pay off the debt and leave early, but the more she thought about it, the more he wanted to delay it longer, deliberately going against her.
After shopkeeper Zhou had a rough understanding of the situation, he asked: "Eldest Master, I will arrange for you to return to Beijing as soon as possible. While you are waiting, do you want to change to live in my home first? "
Although the eldest son now lives in his benefactor's house, the Bao family has been in decline for a long time, and the food and clothing must not be very good, so he is completely unworthy of the eldest son's status.
"No need to bother, I don't want to go back to Beijing yet, and I won't change my place to live with you. ” He refused simply.
"Huh? Why? "Shopkeeper Zhou's eyes widened in surprise.
"Anyway, you just need to report that I am safe and sound. I will keep in touch with you during this period and don't let others know my true identity. "He is very interested in Bao An'er and doesn't want to leave too soon. If his true identity is exposed too soon, it won't be fun, so he plans to maintain his current identity for the time being and stay with him.
Because he has seen too many women wooing him because of his prominent family background, he is extremely disgusted with women who are only interested in profit, and he does not believe that such women can be sincere.
Logically speaking, Bao An'er should be the woman he hates, but she is different from those women. Although she cares about everything, she rescued him who was in trouble, penniless, and seemingly "unprofitable".
If she was truly mercenary, why did she need to save him and take care of him all the way until he recovered?
He didn't believe her ridiculous reason for "a momentary mistake". Besides, although she always complained, she still had a lot of things to take care of. This was the reason why he was interested in her and wanted to get to know her better.
"The little one knows. "Although Shopkeeper Zhou doesn't understand what Qi Wushuang is thinking, Zhu Zhu has decided so, and as a subordinate, of course he will follow it.
"By the way, Shopkeeper Zhou, how much do you know about the Bao family? "They rarely talk about their own affairs, so he only knows a rough idea. Of course, it's not convenient to ask them directly, so he has to ask others.
"The Bao family is quite famous in Xuanhe County, and what happens in their family is something everyone likes to discuss after dinner. The younger one can tell the eldest son everything he knows. "
"Then say it quickly, the more detailed the better. "Qi Wushuang nodded, looking forward to hearing something from Shopkeeper Zhou.
"The Bao family is a wealthy family that specializes in antique trading in Xuanhe County. Master Bao has a son and a daughter. The son is Baokang, and the daughter is Bao An'er. Mrs. Bao died of illness a few years after giving birth to her daughter, and Master Bao was mad to death three years ago. "
"What's going on? "Qi Wushuang raised his eyebrows in surprise.
"Because Baokang was an idle playboy who only knew how to hang out in gambling houses all day long. He lost half of the Bao family's property in just a few years. Master Bao and his son had a dispute, but Baokang was always stubborn. One day three years ago, Master Bao was really angry to death. After Master Bao died, the servants of the Bao family left one after another. Now there is only one noble uncle left who refuses to leave. "
